scope: Finite candidates: maize fertilizer product [0,300,600] kg/ha, each crop irrigation [0,60,120,180] mm; fixed dates, cultivar, weather, geometry and public prices. No claim of global optimum. Plus full adjacent dose combinations at steps (75kg product/ha,15mm,15mm), and center-dose irrigation-date alternatives {-7,0,+7} days; two starts (best refined and best zero-fertilizer), both stopped only after no improving neighbor. No optimization over sowing date, density, field geometry, N timing or arbitrary management schedules.
notes: Cropwise maximum yields are marginal bounds and need not be jointly achievable.
Harvest follows publicly observed maturity/moisture and rain-free dates after September check windows.
No preset yield threshold; report feasibility, margin regret, crop-specific yields, costs and shared water separately.
